```{r}
library(ggplot2)

dc_thefts <- data.frame(
  year = c(2021, 2023, 2024, 2025),
  thefts = c(2500, 6750, 5127, 3933)
)

View(dc_thefts)

ggplot(dc_thefts, aes(x = year, y = thefts)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .7) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = thefts), vjust = 2.3) +
  labs(
    title = "D.C. motor vehicle thefts peaked in 2023",
    subtitle = "Thefts rose after 2021 before dropping in 2024 and 2025",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Motor vehicle thefts",
    caption = "Source: Metropolitan Police Department"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = dc_thefts$year) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("dc-thefts-line-chart.png", width = 7, height = 5)
```
